Firecrawl announced its $75 million Series B on September 22, 2026. Smash Capital led the round, and Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures participated. The announcement coincided with the launch of Alexandria, a data platform for AI agents. Firecrawl funding reached $75 million in a Series B announced on 22 September 2026. Smash Capital led the round with Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle and Offline Ventures participating.

Some reporting says the lead was Smash Ventures, not Smash Capital, so the firm's exact name varies by source.

A separate SEC filing reported a different figure. RuntimeWire scooped the financing on September 14th by monitoring SEC filings. A Form D from Firecrawl's legal issuer, SideGuide Technologies Inc., showed $82,063,463 of preferred stock sold to seven investors, with the first sale recorded on August 31st. Another source notes that without company reconciliation, the safe statement is that Firecrawl announced a $75 million Series B and a filing was reported with a different figure. The round's valuation was not disclosed.

content.text:
Firecrawl announced its $75M Series B on **September 22, 2026** (led by Smash Capital; one outlet says Smash Ventures), alongside the Alexandria launch. These are the launches since then, from Firecrawl's changelog and blog. Dates are as shown on those pages.

| Date | Launch |
|---|---|
| Sep 22, 2026 | **Alexandria**, a data platform for AI agents, launched with the Series B. |
| Sep 24, 2026 | Alexandria is now in Claude and Claude Code. |
| Sep 29, 2026 | Alexandria and the Developer Index are now in ChatGPT and Codex. |
| Oct 1, 2026 | People and company enrichment in Alexandria. The blog names Apollo, FullEnrich and Data Legion as providers. |
| Oct 6, 2026 | Fantasy sports data in Alexandria. |
| Oct 6, 2026 | Firecrawl becomes an official ChatGPT plugin. This is on the blog only, not in the changelog. |
| Oct 8, 2026 | **Universal Scrape**: one API for web pages, files and Alexandria provider context. |
| Oct 13, 2026 | Marketing Data Pack in Alexandria. |
| Oct 15, 2026 | **Fireround**. The changelog lists it but gives no description, and I didn't open the post. |

- **Blog scan is partial:** the blog page was cut off at about two-thirds, so I read only its newer entries. The changelog was complete.
- **Series B date:** the Series B post is dated Sep 22 on both the changelog and the blog. Other outlets reported the round earlier from an SEC Form D filing, with a different figure of about $82M raised.
